text:
cara-docs: FYI opened a short PR to update Triton-11B model card with variant table, seq limits, and a tiny SDK v2 snippet (https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/1499). Need quick eyes on the limits and any broken links.

vik-eng: Thanks. Quick note: we benchmarked `triton-11b-q4_k_m` default safely at 4096 on orion; with `profile='high-memory'` we validated up to 8192 on orion-x. Recommend calling out both values as default vs profile-enabled and mark HW dependency.

jordyn-devex: CI flagged a broken anchor from the card to the profiles section: card links to `#runtime-profiles` but site anchor is `#profiles`.

ci-bot: link-checker: 1 failure — sources/docs/model-catalog/triton-11b.md: anchor '#runtime-profiles' not found.

cara-docs: I'll fix the anchor to `#profiles` and add a concise note: "Default limits are conservative; request `profile='high-memory'` to opt into extended seq limits where supported." Also will include the v2 snippet using `profile`.

vik-eng: For the snippet use `profile` param (not `runtime_profile`) and add a commented line showing `triton-11b-fp16` as a lower-latency alternative. Also add a one-line fallback note: router may fallback to a compatible variant or another region if profile unavailable (can affect latency).

jordyn-devex: Agreed. Can you also add a tiny benchmark footnote (non-normative)? e.g., "~34 tok/s @seq=2048 (orion, batch=1) for q4; ~16 tok/s @seq=8192 under high-memory" with test conditions.

cara-docs: Added snippet and footnote. Snippet:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
# q4 with profile request
resp = client.generate(model='triton-11b-q4_k_m', input='Summarize...', profile='high-memory')
print(resp.text)
# for lower latency use: model='triton-11b-fp16'
```

ci-bot: pr-check: doc-lint passed, link-checker passed.

vik-eng: Tiny edit request: add parenthetical reference to routing policy name `prefer-profile` so ops can find it quickly.

cara-docs: Done (added parenthetical link to routing doc and policy name).

jordyn-devex: Two micro copy edits and then I can approve.

vik-eng: Approved.

cara-docs: Merged. Thanks all — I'll monitor #support for any follow-up. :shipit:
